def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    obs = observe()
    cands = grasp_candidates(obj_name)
    # Grasp near the top of the object (highest grasp candidate)
    cand = max(cands, key=lambda c: c["height"])
    grasp(cand)

    obs = observe()
    zone = obs["zones"][zone_name]
    hx, hy, _ = zone["center"]
    rim_h = zone.get("rim_height", 0.092)
    table_z = obs["table_z"]

    # Carry above holder
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.16)

    # Orient object vertically (along z-axis) by aligning gripper side vector with z
    z_target = table_z + rim_h + 0.12
    orientations = [
        ([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
        ([0, 1, 0], [-1, 0, 0]),
        ([-1, 0, 0], [0, -1, 0]),
        ([0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
    ]
    for app, f_ax in orientations:
        if solve_ik(hx, hy, z_target, approach=app, finger_axis=f_ax)["reachable"]:
            move_gripper(hx, hy, z_target, approach=app, finger_axis=f_ax, path="joint")
            break

    # Lower into holder and release
    move_by(dz=-0.07)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
skills.expected_effect: object resting inside the zone footprint, gripper open, arm lifted

conditions.notes: Grasps an elongated object near its top and inserts it vertically into a container or holder.

origin.source_code:
obs = observe()
target_name = "yellow_pen" if "yellow_pen" in obs["objects"] else "yellow_mug"

cands = grasp_candidates(target_name)
# Candidate 0 had height 0.046 and got blocked by the rim/pen at z=0.889.
# Candidate 1 has height 0.080, near the top of the object resting on the rim!
cand = max(cands, key=lambda c: c["height"])

# Or grasp near the end/top that extends above the rim
grasp(cand)

holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.092)
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Carry above holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.16)

# Turn pen vertical: when held across its short axis, the pen lies along the 'side' vector (approach x finger_axis).
# approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0] -> side = [0, 0, 1] (pen is aligned with z-axis, vertical!)
z_target = table_z + rim_h + 0.12
for app, f_ax in [([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]), ([0, 1, 0], [-1, 0, 0]), ([-1, 0, 0], [0, -1, 0])]:
    if solve_ik(hx, hy, z_target, approach=app, finger_axis=f_ax)["reachable"]:
        move_gripper(hx, hy, z_target, approach=app, finger_axis=f_ax, path="joint")
        break

# Lower the vertical pen into the cup
move_by(dz=-0.07)
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")

lessons.lesson: Instead of attempting an unreachable horizontal gripper approach with move_gripper to tilt the pen vertically, place or drop the pen into the holder using standard top-down vertical alignment or drop_into with normal gripper orientation.
Release the pen directly above the holder opening from above the rim instead of lowering until contact, which causes the horizontal pen to collide with the rim.
Grasp the pen near one of its ends along the long axis rather than at the center so it hangs or drops vertically into the holder opening.

Offset the grasp position toward one end of the pen along its long axis and pitch the gripper at a reachable angle (such as 45 to 60 degrees) so the pen enters the holder opening vertically or diagonally before release.
